description: Seismic exposure data: Yemen is a data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by Global Earthquake Model Foundation. This data was developed as part of the Modelling Exposure Through Earth Observation Routines (METEOR) project and is a Level 1, or a global-quality exposure data set. Minimal country-specific data was collected. The data is intended for CAT modeling and loss estimation. Repurposing this data for any reason other than assessing risk is not recommended. Coverage: Yemen. The portal files it under the publisher Global Earthquake Model Foundation. Its tags are disaster risk reduction-drr, hazards and risk. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2021-04-06 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
